content.comment_body: Hello! I'm encountering issues with Ethernet communication between [product_name] and [product_name] module. The red LED on the [product_name] module stays on, though I believe my setup is correct. Could someone assist? Here’s a YouTube link for reference: [url]. IP addresses used: [product_name] IP: 192.168.0.1, [product_name] Operator Panel IP: 192.168.0.2, [product_name] module IP: 192.168.0.3. Thank you! Apologies for my English.

Check out this link: [url]. It seems you may have a newer [product_name] module. To ensure compatibility, update your [product_name] module to the latest [version_no] firmware version since encrypted connection is now required. Best regards, [user_name]
Thank you for your assistance! I've performed the update, but the LED remains red. Do you have any other suggestions?
Could you share what’s displayed in the diagnostic buffer? Also, did you configure secure communication for your [product_name] 8.3 module during monitoring?

Where is the communication security setting located? The diagnostic buffer messages include: INFO - Configuration completed and monitoring started; ERROR - Mobile data service not available; ERROR - Secure connection to [product_name] BM 8.3 or higher cannot be established, certificate verification failed; WARN - Login attempt failed; INFO - Connection to wireless network established; and several other status updates.

It appears you’re utilizing the communication profile for [product_name] BM 8.3 and above. The diagnostic buffer indicates certificate validation failure. Try synchronizing the [product_name] module’s system time with your PC. Go to System > SystemTime and click 'apply PC time.' Incorrect system time might be causing certificate issues. Regards, [user_name]
It works now! The issue was due to the incorrect system time. Thanks very much!
Hello, could you explain how you resolved the issue? I’m facing the same problem and attempted to set the PC time, but it didn’t resolve for me.
Enable Ethernet communication in the configuration software under general settings for [product_name]. I’ve attached a screenshot for reference.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face notable challenges configuring secure Ethernet connections between [product_name] modules, especially regarding failed certificate verification caused by mismatched system times. The troubleshooting process benefits from access to error logs and accurate configuration guidance, including firmware updates and specific settings in the configuration software. However, such guidance is not always intuitive, resulting in additional friction.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a seamless and transparent setup experience for secure Ethernet communication between modules, with diagnostic tools and configuration software offering clear and actionable feedback for problem resolution. They expect the setup process and troubleshooting steps to be straightforward and supported by detailed logs.
